_comment: Copy this file to connections.json (git-ignored) and fill in real values. NEVER commit connections.json.

estock_source._role: READ-ONLY source to mirror during transition. ProCare NEVER writes here.
estock_source._store_branch_map: Maps eStock store_id -> ProCare branch code. Missing codes are auto-created on first sync. On the live Elsanta server store 1 = the pharmacy and store 2 = the expired-items depot; both fold into the single ELSANTA branch (Procare has only two pharmacies: Elsanta + Mas-hala).

_estock_sources: Multi-branch: one entry PER branch server, each with its own store_branch_map. When present this list replaces estock_source for the continuous sync; every source refreshes only its own branches in the one ProCare database.

titan_drugeye_source._role: READ-ONLY clinical source: product names + drug substitution/interactions.

_procare_database_windows_auth: Dev laptop with SQL Server Express: the installer creates a NAMED instance and Windows-auth-only. Use "server": "localhost\\SQLEXPRESS" (escaped backslash), OMIT "port" (SQL Browser resolves a named instance; a port would override the instance name), and set "trusted_connection": true INSTEAD of username/password — the signed-in Windows account authenticates. Example: {"driver": "ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server", "server": "localhost\\SQLEXPRESS", "database": "ProCare", "trusted_connection": true, "encrypt": "yes", "trust_server_certificate": "yes"}

procare_database._role: ProCare OS OWN database — the new system of record. Read/write.

programs.estock_app_path: TBD_(confirm install path of eStock app)

notifications._manager_phone: Manager WhatsApp for operational alerts (transfer requests, daily report, expiry/reorder). Egyptian 01xxxxxxxxx is fine. Or set env MANAGER_PHONE. Needs WHATSAPP_TOKEN + WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID to actually send.

ai._providers: gemini (Gemini Pro FREE tier, GEMINI_API_KEY) | hermes (Nous Hermes FREE models via OpenRouter, OPENROUTER_API_KEY; aliases: openrouter, nous) | anthropic (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) | ollama (local server, no key) | claude-cli (local Claude Code binary, no key) | hermes-cli (local Hermes binary, no key; HERMES_CLI_BIN/HERMES_CLI_ARGS override it).
ai._model: Leave empty to take the provider's free-tier default (gemini -> gemini-2.5-pro, hermes -> a Nous Hermes :free slug). Set gemini-flash-latest for the faster/cheaper Gemini tier.
ai._base_url: Only used by the OpenAI-compatible providers, and only when this block targets the ACTIVE provider. hermes defaults to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, ollama to http://localhost:11434. Override with AI_BASE_URL / OLLAMA_BASE_URL.
